page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top centre above the list; page number top left. Upper block: a list of Persian month names in Arabic script (left) with Latin equivalents (right), no column heads. Then a centred heading line. Then a second list: Ethiopic month names (left) with Latin equivalents (right). Below, a full-width paragraph of text with Greek and Arabic words inline, ending with a line at the right. Digitiser's watermark at lower right is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Dies intercalares sive Epagomenæ Persæ vocant مستر قة
Musteraka, hoc est καλοπιμὸς Furtivus, & ad finem cujusque

page.notes: Ethiopic and Arabic lines are reproduced as far as legible; the Ethiopic spellings and the Arabic Persian forms may contain small errors from the scan. The Greek phrase "καλοπιμὸς" is a best reading. The Persian word in the final paragraph is partly illegible. The Ethiopic column is partly faded.
